第975章 【游戏竞技场】开启，激战与死斗（6000字大章）-《废土藏身处，从下水道开始升级》
第975章 【游戏竞技场】开启，激战与死斗（6000字大章）-《废土藏身处，从下水道开始升级》
血腥主宰和深海之喉身上却被深紫色雪花状的能量笼罩， 与于渊的格式化力量进行着抗衡。
在于渊的感知中，新世界都在规则的笼罩之内，但斯洛神庙就像一个规则破坏者。
他也没想到血腥主宰明明已经被斯洛神庙控制，看样子竟然还有自己的思维和意识。
没道理对低级生命直接污染掠夺，到了高级别后污染就不再生效了吧！
“或者说，污染和傀儡化都是斯洛神庙的手段，只不过精神污染针对低级生命更方便而已。高级生命的精神抗性已经足够高，所以才选择直接傀儡化控制。”
在于渊陷入思索的时候，斯洛神庙的身后再次浮现出那道巨大的玩偶虚影。
却在来到于渊身侧10公分的时候，与一层薄膜碰撞在了一起，顿时显现出来。
“难怪，神话级的存在都能被轻易控制，无法发现丝毫异常，原来拥有篡改规则的效果。”
在于渊的视野中， 每一根丝线上面都有浓郁的规则痕迹，这是这些规则伪装的效果，让丝线拥有无法被探察和躲避的效果。
也就于渊现在已经拥有掌控整个宇宙群落的能力，他的无尽帷幕同样属于规则之力。
只是瞬间，斯洛神庙笼罩在血腥主宰和深海之喉身上的规则之力，碾压消散。
紫黑色的气息从中向外扩散，于渊也第一时间感知到，宇宙群落的无尽帷幕之前，一个黑洞快速靠近。
黑洞与无尽帷幕发生碰撞，紫黑色气息沿着无尽帷幕将整个宇宙群落笼罩。
于渊看着神庙上空，几乎化为实质的巨大玩偶傀儡，眼眸也是微微眯起。
飞船上空，不出意外地已经凝聚出几道模糊不清的身影，正是于渊从飞船遗迹所在的文明宇宙召唤来的强者投影。
“既然飞船能将神庙压制这么多年，那或许现在这道文明宇宙投影，也会有一些意外惊喜。”
命运之书在眼前浮现，随着书页翻动，这段时间以来 搜集的天象卡全部都在这里，能够增强战力的天象卡、情报卡全部激活。
效果：神秘侧能力、神职、神性效果大幅提升，对污染、黑暗、负面类存在具有克制效果

无尽胃袋在于渊头顶上空不断变大，胃袋张开，恐惧的吸力将整个天空笼罩。
来者不拒的特性原本让于渊都不敢轻易使用，但现在随着胃袋的吸收，那些悬浮在神庙下方的丝线全部被强行吸收了过来。
镜中妖精就是没有实体，被一面面镜子在神庙周围浮现，开始构筑镜中空间。
在吸收飞船遗迹控制舱内那棵大树的时候，曾经有过一段影像，开头部分显示过一座身披斗篷的雕像投影。
就看到那道身影身后冲出现一道巨大的阴影，化作一道骑着骏马的黑影，手持长刀向那座神庙冲去。
在黑影冲出的时候，神庙就做出反应，神庙上空的玩偶虚影，感受到了威胁，双臂环抱神庙，玩偶的眼中也是红芒四色。

Chapter 975 [Game Arena] opens, fierce battles and death battles (6,000 words long chapter) - "Wasteland Hideout, Upgrade from the Sewers"
Chapter 975 [Game Arena] opens, fierce battles and death battles (6,000 words long chapter) - "Wasteland Hideout, Upgrade from the Sewers"
The Blood Lord and the Throat of the Deep Sea were shrouded in dark purple snowflake-like energy, competing with Yu Yuan's formatting power.
In Yu Yuan's perception, the new world is surrounded by rules, but the Sluo Temple is like a rule breaker.
He also didn't expect that the bloody master had been controlled by the Sluo Temple, and it seemed that he still had his own thoughts and consciousness.
There is no reason to directly pollute and plunder low-level beings. Once you reach a high level, pollution will no longer take effect, right?
"In other words, pollution and puppetization are both methods of the Sluo Temple, but mental pollution is more convenient for low-level life. The spiritual resistance of high-level life is already high enough, so we chose direct puppet control."
When Yu Yuan was lost in thought, the huge doll silhouette appeared again behind the Sluo Temple.
But when it came to 10 centimeters from Yu Yuan's side, it collided with a thin film, and it suddenly appeared.
"No wonder, myth-level existences can be easily controlled without being able to detect the slightest abnormality. It turns out to have the effect of tampering with the rules."
In Yu Yuan's field of vision, every thread has strong traces of rules. This is the camouflage effect of these rules, making the threads impossible to detect and avoid.
That is to say, Yu Yuan now has the ability to control the entire universe community, and his endless curtain also belongs to the power of rules.
In just an instant, the power of rules that shrouded the Blood Lord and the Throat of the Deep Sea in the Sluo Temple crushed and dissipated.
Purple-black aura spread outwards from it, and Yu Yuan immediately sensed that a black hole was rapidly approaching in front of the endless curtain of the cosmic community.
The black hole collided with the endless curtain, and the purple-black aura enveloped the entire universe along the endless curtain.
Yu Yuan looked at the huge doll puppet that had almost turned into reality above the temple, and his eyes narrowed slightly.
In the sky above the spaceship, as expected, several vague figures have condensed. They are the projections of powerful men summoned by Yu Yuan from the civilized universe where the ruins of the spaceship are located.
"Since the spaceship has been able to suppress the temple for so many years, maybe there will be some unexpected surprises in this projection of the civilized universe."
The Book of Destiny appeared in front of my eyes. As the pages of the book turned, all the celestial cards collected during this period were here, and all the celestial cards and intelligence cards that could enhance combat power were activated.
Effect: The mysterious side ability, priesthood, and divinity effects are greatly improved, and it has a restraining effect on pollution, darkness, and negative existences.
The endless stomach bag continued to grow in size above Yu Yuan's head, the stomach bag opened, and the suction of fear enveloped the entire sky.
The characteristic of not rejecting anyone originally made Yu Yuan dare not use it easily, but now with the absorption of the stomach bag, all the silk threads suspended under the temple have been forcibly absorbed.
The mirror goblin has no real entity. It appears in the mirrors around the temple and begins to build the mirror space.
When absorbing the big tree in the control cabin of the spacecraft ruins, there was a video, and the beginning showed the projection of a cloaked statue.
I saw a huge shadow rushing out behind the figure, turning into a black figure riding a horse, holding a long knife and rushing towards the temple.
When the black shadow rushed out, the temple reacted. The doll's shadow above the temple felt the threat and wrapped its arms around the temple. The doll's eyes were also red.
